description: Machine-readable capability matrix for Agent Baton adapters

claude.name: Claude Code

hookEnforcement.mechanism: PreToolUse hook matching Edit|Write|MultiEdit executes baton guard --agent claude --hook claude with tool-call JSON on stdin. Exit code 2 + stderr halts tool execution.

cloudCiReadiness.ciIntegration: Headless CLI execution via CI steps when supplied with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
cloudCiReadiness.notes: Requires non-interactive invocation flags; interactive prompts must be suppressed in CI.

offlineCliExecution.notes: Baton ledger, status, guard, verify, and worktree operations are 100% offline. Model inference requires provider API.

limitations: Interactive CLI session by default; does not manage background daemon tasks without external orchestration.
PreToolUse hook guards file edits; shell commands (Bash) must be restricted via Baton permission profile.

codex.name: Codex CLI

hookEnforcement.mechanism: Generic shell/env wrapper (BATON_AGENT=codex baton guard --hook generic) and baton verify gates.

cloudCiReadiness.ciIntegration: Scriptable non-interactive runner with OPENAI_API_KEY in CI pipelines
cloudCiReadiness.notes: Native headless support makes it well-suited for automated test & fix workflows.

offlineCliExecution.notes: Baton core is fully offline; Codex CLI commands execute against configured local or remote API endpoint.

limitations: No native PreToolUse hook configuration in standard Codex CLI to intercept tool calls pre-execution; relies on wrapper and verify gates.
Runs single-pass jobs rather than persistent resident background daemons.

gemini.name: Gemini CLI

hookEnforcement.mechanism: Command-level execution with BATON_AGENT=gemini; verify gate validation on packet submission.

cloudCiReadiness.ciIntegration: Headless CLI invocation in automated runner environments with GEMINI_API_KEY
cloudCiReadiness.notes: Command TOML files provide structured shortcuts for baton subcommands.

offlineCliExecution.notes: Baton operations are completely offline; Gemini model execution queries provider endpoints.

limitations: Lacks native IDE hook interception; relies on verify gates for scope boundary enforcement.
Interactive CLI orientation; does not manage an autonomous background task loop.

antigravity.name: Google Antigravity

hookEnforcement.mechanism: Constitutional agent rules in .agent/rules/baton.md combined with AGENT_BUS claim enforcement, skill pre-flight validation, and baton guard/verify execution.

cloudCiReadiness.ciIntegration: Containerized agent runtime and headless dispatch supported across cloud environments
cloudCiReadiness.notes: Native multi-agent coordination matches Baton's decentralized packet dispatch model.

offlineCliExecution.notes: Baton coordination, ledger state, and verification are 100% offline.

limitations: Advanced multi-agent features require full Antigravity environment supporting subagent invocations.
Tool permission gates enforce Baton boundaries within the active workspace session.

cursor.name: Cursor

hookEnforcement.mechanism: Supports baton guard --hook cursor yielding JSON output on stdout: { permission: 'deny'|'allow', user_message, agent_message } with exit code 2 on deny.

cloudCiReadiness.ciIntegration: Not designed for headless CI; verification occurs via baton verify in standard CI workflows
cloudCiReadiness.notes: Desktop GUI application; cannot be executed as a headless CI runner.

offlineCliExecution.notes: Baton CLI commands execute offline from Cursor terminal. Cursor AI features require cloud connectivity.

limitations: Instruction and editor surface only; does not provide an unattended background execution daemon.
Guard hook is not auto-installed into Cursor settings; requires manual hook wiring or post-edit baton verify.

copilot.name: GitHub Copilot

hookEnforcement.mechanism: GitHub Actions CI check enforcement (.github/workflows/baton-ci.yml), PR review status gates, and pre-commit hooks.

cloudCiReadiness.ciIntegration: Native GitHub Actions integration via baton dispatch and workflow automation
cloudCiReadiness.notes: Excellent cloud dispatch support through baton dispatch <packet> --to copilot and CI check runs.

offlineCliExecution.notes: Baton CLI commands run offline. Copilot coding suggestions and cloud dispatch require GitHub connectivity.

limitations: Local editor extension is instruction-driven; local background daemon execution is not supported.
PreToolUse interceptor is not available inside the local editor; protection relies on CI and verify gates.

windsurf.name: Windsurf

hookEnforcement.mechanism: Rules and workflow files guide agent execution; verification relies on baton verify post-step check.

cloudCiReadiness.ciIntegration: Desktop GUI application; validation in CI runs via baton check and baton verify
cloudCiReadiness.notes: Not designed for headless execution in CI.

offlineCliExecution.notes: Baton operations from the embedded terminal run 100% offline.

limitations: Instruction surface only; does not provide an executable headless runner or unattended daemon.
No native tool interception hook; relies on conversational guidance and post-edit verification.

cline.name: Cline

hookEnforcement.mechanism: Rules file prompts agent to respect Baton ownership and invoke baton verify before claiming completion.

cloudCiReadiness.ciIntegration: VS Code desktop extension; CI verification relies on repository-level baton verify gates
cloudCiReadiness.notes: Requires interactive VS Code extension environment.

offlineCliExecution.notes: Baton CLI commands execute offline from VS Code terminal.

limitations: Instruction surface only; no headless runner CLI or background daemon capability.
Role separation is prompt-guided within a single .clinerules/baton.md definition rather than dedicated subagents.

opencode.name: OpenCode

hookEnforcement.mechanism: Generic shell/env wrapper (BATON_AGENT=opencode baton guard --hook generic) and post-step verification.

cloudCiReadiness.ciIntegration: CLI-driven execution in containerized or cloud CI runner pipelines
cloudCiReadiness.notes: Native subagent definitions align cleanly with Baton multi-role workflows.

offlineCliExecution.notes: Baton operations are completely offline; model execution depends on configured local or remote provider.

limitations: Does not maintain an unattended background daemon; runs per task invocation.
No PreToolUse interceptor in base configuration; relies on environment wrappers and verification gates.

aider.name: Aider

hookEnforcement.mechanism: Git pre-commit hooks and baton verify execution prior to committing changes.

cloudCiReadiness.ciIntegration: Can be executed in scripted mode with --message / --yes in CI pipelines
cloudCiReadiness.notes: Git-centric architecture integrates directly with repository branches.

offlineCliExecution.notes: Baton CLI is 100% offline; Aider connects to configured LLM.

limitations: Designed primarily for pair-programming and worker code generation; lacks dedicated multi-agent subagent definitions.
Does not operate as an unattended background daemon.

custom.name: Custom agent

hookEnforcement.mechanism: baton guard --hook generic and baton verify gates invoked by custom runner scripts.

cloudCiReadiness.ciIntegration: Invoked via baton prompt <role> --agent <id> in custom scripts and CI jobs
cloudCiReadiness.notes: Provides standard prompt templates for any custom agent.

limitations: User must provide execution runtime and connect prompts to model interfaces.
No automatic hook installation; must be integrated into custom tool pipeline.
